title: Marie S Possible NDE 7835
content: On April 14 2015, I had to have an operation under general anesthesia for a fractured wrist. I returned to the operating room at the end of my journey. I have no idea the precise hour of the operation. I was in a great deal of pain and I didn’t have a watch. During the procedure, an extraordinary thing happened. In the distance I saw a light, and I went back into the Light. I don’t remember having gone through a tunnel. The light was a very intensely bright, but not blinding, light. I could hear sublime music that sounded like love songs. I knew at that moment that I am not alone in the world. I felt an unconditional and infinite love. I had never felt so bathed in love and I had never felt anything like that since. I was immersed in this ocean of love and an inexpressible joy rose in my heart. There are not big enough words to explain my happiness. I felt completely understood, fulfilled, and loved just as I am. I was so far from the cares and worries of this earth! I was no longer aware of time or space, but of being, of always having been present. I understood that I am part of this light; that I am eternal. I still had a body, but I was not my physical body. I was floating. The feeling of peace and abundance was pervasive. I met some beings of love. I could not see them, but I felt their presence. They were made of light. They told me that I was there to show me that there is something to believe in after death. I asked to see my father, but they told me 'No' in a categorically firm and loving way. I continued to ask; I even begged to see him, or at least perceive him in some way. But the response was still a loving 'No, not now. It is not your time, and you will come back.' I have never experienced anything as powerful or as clear. I found myself back in my body, I had no pain coming back to my body. When I awoke, I cried because I didn’t get to see my father, but at the same time I was filled with joy at having been in this light; feeling all that love and kindness. The mixture of sadness and joy is difficult to explain, but I know that I was privileged to have had this experience. It will never leave me, and I wish everyone could experience it. After this experience, I see life and things differently. It was a strong internal experience that transformed me. I am more spiritual.

arrival.other_being_detail: Met 'beings of love' whose presence was felt but not seen; described as 'made of light.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Sublime music 'like love songs' and an 'ocean of love.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Beings told her she was shown this to demonstrate 'that there is something to believe in after death.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Auditory component: sublime music; beings refused request to see father and stated she would return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel recalled; experience centered on entering/being in intense light with loving beings, then being told to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Occurred under general anesthesia during wrist surgery; prominent 'music that sounded like love songs.' Beings were felt but not seen.
